02Who am I?

Who is behind the work

[ Portrait photo ]

A software engineer's mind, working in marketing.

Short bio

I'm Mohamed Yasser, 23, Marketing Manager at MarQuota. I build the strategy, the media plan and the business plan for the brands I manage, and I follow the numbers all the way to sales.

Background

I graduated in Computer Science, Software Engineering track, and moved into marketing a year ago. I started as a data analyst at Studio Plus, building performance dashboards for every client, then took over marketing at MarQuota across dental, furniture, gifting, pet-tech and vending-tech brands.

Approach

I treat a brand like a system. Software taught me to debug before I build: find the real problem, read the data, design the fix, ship it, measure, iterate. In marketing that means diagnosing the business before anyone opens a content calendar.

03How I think

The order matters

“What should we post?” “What does the business actually need?”
  1. BusinessWhat the company sells, to whom, and how it makes money.
  2. Business diagnosisWhere it's actually stuck: demand, conversion, retention, operations.
  3. MarketSize, trends, and the forces shaping the category.
  4. CustomerWho buys, why, and what stops them.
  5. CompetitorsWho else wins the same customer, and how.
  6. PositioningThe space the brand can own.
  7. ObjectivesMeasurable targets tied to business outcomes.
  8. StrategyThe plan that connects the objectives to the market.
  9. Content / Creative / PerformanceExecution comes last, because now it has a reason.
Marketing × Sales × Operations

A campaign that brings demand the sales team can't close, or orders operations can't deliver, is wasted budget. So I plan the three together: marketing creates the demand, sales converts it, operations keeps the promise.
